description: Update a player profile's settings. Covers: player colors (colors.primaryColor / controlsColor), enabled controls list, smart autoplay (vsl.smartAutoplay), VSL mode (vsl.disablePause / disableForward / alternativeProgress), playback speed (general.default_speed), save progress, big play button (use panda_update_video_config — that lives elsewhere), and SUBTITLE APPEARANCE: caption text/background colors (captions.foreground / captions.background — 8-char hex with alpha) and caption font size (general.fontSize as keyword 'extraSmall'|'small'|'normal'|'large'|'extraLarge', plus general.fontSizePx as the matching pixel number). When the user names a UI label like "extra pequeno" / "extra small", map it to the corresponding fontSize keyword and send both fontSize + fontSizePx. Do NOT use this tool for: chapters (use panda_update_video_config), subtitle generation (use panda_generate_ai_subtitles), thumbnails, or title/description (use panda_update_video). Each nested object REPLACES the existing one — send the COMPLETE object you want to keep.

captions.description: Per-video subtitle (caption) appearance — text and background colors (v2 dashboard).

background.description: Subtitle background color as 8-char hex with alpha — `RRGGBBAA`, e.g. '000000B3' = 70% opaque black.

foreground.description: Subtitle text color as 8-char hex with alpha — `RRGGBBAA`, e.g. 'FFFFFFFF' = opaque white.

captionsColor.description: (Legacy) Subtitle text color (hex). Prefer `captions.foreground` on the modern subtitle editor.

controls.description: Array of enabled player controls (incl. "play-large" = Botão de Play Grande). Values: "play-large", "rewind", "play", "fast-forward", "progress", "current-time", "volume", "captions", "settings", "pip", "fullscreen", "airplay", "cast"

exclusive.description: Dedicate/restrict the profile to a single video

general.description: General player + subtitle settings (speed, font size, search-in-video, defaults).

fontSize.description: Subtitle font size keyword: extraSmall=10px, small=12px, normal=14px(default), large=16px, extraLarge=18px. Send fontSizePx alongside.

fontSizePx.description: Subtitle font size in px — must match fontSize: 10/12/14/16/18.

searchInsideVideo.description: Enable smart search inside the video (same semantic as legacy smartSearch).

smartSearch.description: (Legacy) Enable smart search in video. v2 sends `searchInsideVideo` — both accepted.

startsWithSubtitle.description: Whether the video starts with the subtitle track visible by default.

name.description: Rename the profile (usually a video ID; 3–100 chars)

vsl.description: VSL (Video Sales Letter) settings — controls autoplay, smart autoplay, fake progress bar, muted indicator

alternativeProgress2xLimit.description: Percentage at which fake progress accelerates

alternativeProgressHeight.description: Fake progress bar height in px

smartAutoplay.description: Smart Autoplay — auto-plays muted, unmutes on interaction

name: panda_update_profile
title: Update Profile
